user.title: Set up Navimow
user.description: Enter a name to identify this Navimow account.

auth.title: Link Navimow Account
auth.description: Log in to your Segway Navimow account in the window that opens. Home Assistant will continue automatically once the login is complete.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Navimow
reauth_confirm.description: The Navimow session has expired. Log in again to restore the connection.

dock.title: Dock position
dock.description:
The mower reports its position in meters from the dock. To show it on the map, place the pin on the dock and set the map rotation.

With rotation 0° the mower map is assumed to point north. If the track on the map is rotated compared to the lawn, adjust the rotation in the integration options: positive values turn it clockwise.

data_description.dock_location: GPS position of the charging dock.
data_description.map_rotation: Clockwise rotation, in degrees, needed to align the mower map with north.
